Messages.Author: JJeff
Messages.Body:
I was just wondering.
When a vamp with a printed title gains another title (be it a smaller
or larger one) then loses the new tityle later, does he gain back his
printed one or is he now a title-less vamp?

Say I played a Kholo card on a Magaji, and the next turn I bring out a
older title-less vamp. The Kholo shifts to the older vamp, that i
know, but will my Magaji become a magaji again?

Thanks

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
JJeff wrote:
> I was just wondering.
> When a vamp with a printed title gains another title (be it a smaller
> or larger one) then loses the new tityle later, does he gain back his
> printed one or is he now a title-less vamp?

No. The old title was lost as soon as the new one was gained. There is no
mechanism to recover the lost title.

> Say I played a Kholo card on a Magaji, and the next turn I bring out a
> older title-less vamp. The Kholo shifts to the older vamp, that i
> know, but will my Magaji become a magaji again?

No.

"Me has 2 votes" titles aren't tied to being independent, so they never go dormant.

> if Thetmes goes Into the Fire and becomes Sabbat, and then becomes an
> Archbishop of Detroit, what happens if he is then Excommunicated?

He loses his title. So he is non-titled.
